title: chat-client: use base-client PushSubscription bindings instead of private chat-flavoured ones
description:
Design: docs/design/emailpush.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: E14. Crates: jmap-chat-client. Size: S.

Follow-up. Design: docs/design/emailpush.md §8.

jmap-chat-client has private chat-flavoured PushSubscription/get and /set code. Once jmap-base-client has the generic push_subscription_get/push_subscription_set (with extra_using), reimplement the chat-client helpers as thin wrappers over them, keeping the public chat-client API unchanged (or #[deprecated] wrappers per the repo stability policy if a signature must change).
Acceptance: existing chat-client tests pass; no duplicate request-building code remains; public-api snapshot shows no unintended change.
